q.q: The height of a perfectly balanced binary tree with n nodes is approximately:
q.x: A balanced binary tree of height h holds about 2^(h+1) - 1 nodes, so height ≈ log2(n).

q.q: Which traversal of a Binary Search Tree (BST) visits elements in sorted (ascending) order?
q.x: Inorder traversal (left, root, right) of a BST yields elements in ascending order.

q.q: In which tree traversal is the root node visited before its left and right subtrees?
q.x: Preorder visits root, then left subtree, then right subtree (root-first).
